result.question: Quais são os 5 hospitais mais eficientes em custo por dia de internação (com mais de 1000 internações)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT h."CNES", ROUND(SUM(i."VAL_TOT") / SUM(i."DIAS_PERM"), 2) AS custo_por_dia FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."DIAS_PERM" > 0 AND i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY custo_por_dia ASC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: WITH hospital_internacoes AS ( SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(i."VAL_TOT") AS total_custo, SUM(i."DIAS_PERM") AS total_dias FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ), custo_por_dia AS ( SELECT "CNES", ROUND(total_custo::numeric / NULLIF(total_dias, 0), 2) AS custo_medio_por_dia FROM hospital_internacoes ) SELECT h."CNES", h."NATUREZA", cpd.custo_medio_por_dia FROM custo_por_dia cpd JOIN hospital h ON cpd."CNES" = h."CNES" ORDER BY cpd.custo_medio_por_dia ASC LIMIT 5;
